**Grant Application: Glocks and Fried Chicken (GAFC)**

**To:** Everytown Safety Fund

**From:** Glocks and Fried Chicken (GAFC)

Glocks and Fried Chicken (GAFC), a minority-owned social enterprise, respectfully requests funding between $50,000 and $200,000 from the Everytown Safety Fund to expand our culturally-competent gun safety education initiatives in Sacramento’s communities of color.

Gun violence disproportionately impacts communities of color in Sacramento, where preventable accidents and tragedies often stem from a lack of fundamental gun safety knowledge, especially among youth. Our approach addresses this critical need head-on.

Our innovative programs include "Gloxsie 21," an engaging cartoon IP teaching responsible gun interaction, and complementary AI education workshops that empower youth with digital literacy and critical thinking. Community workshops, hosted with our trusted partner Church of Legacy, provide hands-on safety training and dialogue.

GAFC's initiatives aim to significantly increase gun safety knowledge among youth, reduce accidental shootings, and foster a culture of responsible interaction with firearms. We anticipate improved community resilience and enhanced digital skills for participants, measured through pre/post surveys and program participation.

As a minority-owned enterprise deeply rooted in the community, GAFC offers culturally-relevant education delivered by trusted voices. Our unique blend of entertainment, technology, and grassroots outreach ensures effective engagement and lasting impact, addressing systemic issues with innovative solutions. Support for GAFC will directly save lives and empower a generation with vital safety skills and future-ready knowledge.
